reason: The cited evidence does not directly support Al substitution in HfMoTaTiZr. E2 discusses elemental effects in Hf-Mo-Nb-Ta-Ti-Zr but not Al; E3 and E4 involve Al in different alloy systems (Al0.8NbTiV and TaNbVTi with Al2O3) and do not address maintaining a single-phase BCC or the specific strength retention claimed. The key premises about Al's strengthening and phase stability in this alloy are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Al substitution reduces density via lower atomic weight
Al introduces lattice distortion and solid-solution strengthening similar to heavy elements
A single-phase BCC solid solution can be maintained with 10 at.% Al substitution
The baseline HfMoTaTiZr has ~1600 MPa RT yield and ~855 MPa at 1000 °C
Density reduction of 5–10% and yield strength within 10% of baseline are achievable
